datasets.title: Myanmar - Satellite-detected damage to cultural heritage in Min Kun as of 03 April 2025
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: EQ20250328MMR, GDACS ID: 1474477 This map shows the locations where damage was detected based on a very high resolution satellite image collected 03 April 2025 when compared to very high resolution satellite imagery from 23 March 2025. The USGS shake map indicates the intentsity of the earthquake measured 8.0 - 8.5 in this area. Across the site 11 damaged cultural heritage locations were observed and an additional 3 have possible damage. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-damage-to-cultural-heritage-in-min-kun-as-of-03-april-2025]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts compared very high resolution satellite imagery acquired before (23 March 2025) and after (03 April 2025) the 28 March 2025 earthquake to detect structural damage to cultural heritage locations in Min Kun. Ground motion intensity data from USGS shake maps provided the hazard context. Damage was classified as confirmed (11 sites) or possible (3 sites) based on visual interpretation, with field validation pending.
